lines.text: As long as you're with me, Commander, I feel safe.
I always have such fun spending time with you.
Your hand is so warm. Can you... touch me a little more?
I wanna go see the kitty.
Is the Commander here? Guess not...
Commander, will you... drop by the Courthouse when you have time?
What is a Courthouse doing in the Outpost?
It's smaller than the Ark, but fully equipped.
Please don't let me be abandoned again...
You must have put your heart and soul into it... Thank you, Commander!
But... I don't have anything to give in return...
I'm a little scared... I think I'm starting to get attached.
Is this all just a wonderful dream?
We've gotten closer... but I may end up regretting it.
This place is dangerous. Let's go somewhere safe.
Let me suit up and I'll be right out.
Target seems to have been cleared.
This task is too difficult for me... I'm sorry!
